nuggets.text: Badgers fans 'Jump Around' between the third and fourth quarters, a Camp Randall tradition since a 1998 homecoming game.
The Badgers' visiting locker room was first painted bright pink, then repainted a calming shade called 'prison blue.'
The Badgers play on the grounds of Camp Randall, a Union Army training camp during the Civil War.
Camp Randall Stadium, the Badgers' home since 1917, is the oldest stadium in the Big Ten.
The Badgers' name comes from early Wisconsin miners who had to 'live like badgers' in hillside tunnels through the winter.
The Badgers' 'Fifth Quarter' fan party has followed every home game since 1969.
Badgers coach Luke Fickell made a school-record 50 straight starts at nose guard for Ohio State from 1993 to 1996.
Badgers coach Luke Fickell was a three-time state wrestling champion at St. Francis DeSales High School in Columbus.
Badgers coach Luke Fickell has six children, including two sets of twin boys; son Landon is a graduate assistant on his staff.
Badgers QB Colton Joseph ran for 1,007 yards at Old Dominion in 2025 and was Sun Belt Offensive Player of the Year.
